QuestInfo.name: [Grand Athenaeum] The White Mage
QuestInfo.0: Centuries ago, a brilliant magician left a cryptic warning for the world... 'The ultimate light can only be found in the ultimate darkness.' His words must be heeded if Maple World is to be saved.
